Love can arise through affection, attraction, care, closeness, shared experience, or seeing a person, animal, object, place, or cause as deeply valuable.

## Words describing love

Adoration, affection, arousal, attraction, caring, compassion, desire, enchantment, fondness, infatuation, kindness, liking, limerence, longing, lust, passion, sympathy, tenderness, and warmth.

## Prompting events and interpretations

Events include care, admiration, attraction, fun, time together, shared experience, and strong communication. Interpretations may see someone as loving, valuable, attractive, reliable, or trustworthy.

## Body changes, expressions, and action urges

Excitement, warmth, calm, openness, trust, energy, or vulnerability may occur. Urges and actions include approaching, touching, sharing, helping, smiling, eye contact, physical closeness, and wanting the best for the person.

## Aftereffects

Attention may focus on positive qualities, with openness, trust, daydreaming, remembered love, confidence, and longing during separation.

## When love fits the facts

Love fits when loving a person, animal, or object enhances quality of life or supports personal goals.

## Acting on the urge, Opposite Action, and Checking the Facts

When love fits and is effective, approach, care, and connect while respecting consent and boundaries. When it does not fit or acting would be harmful, avoid contact and reminders, redirect repeated thoughts, review the costs, and reduce idealizing.
